english: Nyonyonyoo♪ Cleaning's done, nyoo♪
Hm? Who left a letter at the register, nyo?\nDid I win a telephone card from a contest, nyo?
Hmm? It's for Rem, nyo?\nDoes Rem enter contests too, nyo?
What's up, Dejiko-chan?\nWin a telephone card in a contest?
Telephone cards are still normal, nyo...\nThis industry, where Rem's era's telephone-card culture\nstill survives, is secretly amazing, nyo...
Oh? A letter for me?
It arrived at the register, nyo.\nWanna read it, nyo?
Let's see, what what?
...Huh, this is...!!
Who's it from, nyo?
...From Doctor Shinigami.
Ah, that... wait!? Really, nyo!?
//fade to black\n//Background: inside Gamers\n//Rem gathers everyone and speaks.
A duel with Doctor Shinigami!?
Yes. Doctor Shinigami specified\nthe place and time in a letter.
But Rem-san, you said yourself\nthere's no way to beat Doctor Shinigami now...
I heard that too.
That's right. There's no way to beat him.
Then why duel him?\nYou're not going there to lose, are you?
Two reasons.\nOne: if I don't go,\nDoctor Shinigami will attack innocent people.
He'd definitely do it.
And the real reason:\nthis head-on approach\nisn't like Doctor Shinigami.
So it might be a fake?
With the black ones around, it's suspicious.
Doctor Shinigami appeared before me\nseveral times before, but\nfor some reason he never tried to kill me.
True... given his history\nof losing to Rem, he should've tried\nto kill Rem first...
And now he's specifying a place and time.\nI want to know why.
Isn't Rem-san afraid of Doctor Shinigami, desuu?
Rem-san fears nothing.\nI've never seen her scared.
You see... I have no dreams.
No dreams? What do you mean?
By the time I was aware of the world,\nmy dreams had already been stolen.\nThe last dream I had is beyond distant memory...
But instead, I was granted\nthe power to enter people's dreams.
That's the same as Doctor Shinigami...?
Yes, the "dream power."\nI don't know how it was given\nto me or Doctor Shinigami.
But I wanted to use the "dream power"\nto help people plagued by nightmares,\nwhile Doctor Shinigami wanted to use it for his desires.
Sworn enemies, then.
I fought Doctor Shinigami many times and beat him.\nThe "dream power" was necessary for that.
But the current Rem-san doesn't have\nthe "dream power," right?
Rem, is that true!?
I told Shirayuki-chan and Rika-chan\na bit ago, but yes.\nMy "dream power" is lost.
That's why Doctor Shinigami said\n"I can't be beaten."
Even dueling, I can't win.\nBut actually, it's always been that way.\nHe could've killed me anytime.
But he didn't...
I want to know why.\nIt might have something to do\nwith me losing the "dream power."
If that's the case, it's decided!
Yeah! I'm going with you, Rem-chan!
You're not going to say you'll go alone now, are you?
But... is it okay?
This is a mystery you have to solve.\nWe'll watch over you.
We can't beat Doctor Shinigami\nany other way.
Let's go. There's nowhere to run anyway.
No backing out\njust because I got here!
//fade to black\n//Background: streets of Rem's world (night)
This is the place... Come out! Doctor Shinigami!
There's no sign of people around...
Even the hyper sensor\ncan't detect humans.
So the stage is set...!
So you've come.
Show yourself! Doctor Shinigami!
No need to rush.\nI neither flee nor hide.
There he is!
Let's settle this!
Wait. The cast isn't assembled yet.
Cast?
Well. Let's move somewhere\nwe won't be disturbed.
Isn't this the final stage?
Hah! No way!
Too late. Now, let's go to the dream world.\nFufufu...!
Sleeping gas...! Ugh...
//Battle map: dream world\n//Initially deployed: Doctor Shinigami, Rem
So this is where we'll do it...!
Shall we warm up a little?\nThe cast will assemble soon.
//Doctor Shinigami sends out nightmare demons.
This won't even warm me up!
//Player deployment.
Rem!
Nightmare demons - leave them to us!
Rem-chan, take Doctor Shinigami!
Got it! Everyone, I'm counting on you!
//Battle start.\n//Event when Rem engages Doctor Shinigami.
Prepare yourself!
Rem, you are brave.\nEven in a battle with not one chance in ten thousand,\nyou feel not a shred of fear.
I've fought all kinds of things!\nI've been torn apart more than once or twice!
And yet a believing heart, strong feelings,\nhave always led me to victory!
With power or without, that won't change!
//Talk event after Doctor Shinigami and Rem engage.
Fufufu, Rem... that's my nemesis,\nRem the Dream Hunter.\nNoble, strong, and beautiful...
Praise from you doesn't make me happy!
But Rem, had it been otherwise, I would have\nkilled you long ago.
Let me tell you why\nI've kept you alive until now.
Now, the cast assembles...
//Black Rem appears.
That's!?
Black Rem-san...!?
She shows up here!? Unbelievable!
Now what will you do?\nShow me courage... open a way out.
You don't have to tell me!\nI'll fight! And I'll win!\nI'll protect people's dreams and happiness!
//Battle resumes. Doctor Shinigami and Black Rem revive even when defeated.
//Event triggers upon defeating Doctor Shinigami.
Hmm... you still haven't learned.
//Doctor Shinigami fully revives. His graphic changes here to a crumbled-face Doctor Shinigami.
He really won't go down...!
I'll say it as many times as needed.\nYou cannot defeat me.\nI'd like you to remember that.
//Event triggers upon defeating Black Rem.
//Black Rem is enveloped in REM-sleep waves and fully revives.
Same as when we fought before... REM-sleep waves\nare protecting my black self!
At this rate...!
Fufufu, as I thought.\nThen...!
//Doctor Shinigami moves near Black Rem.
Rem, do you remember?\nWhen we fought, I used\na device that erases REM-sleep waves!
I remember... huh!? No way!!
What happens if I use this, I wonder?
//Doctor Shinigami uses the device that erases REM-sleep waves.
With this, the REM-sleep waves\nprotecting her are gone.
Rem, what you seek\nis right there.\nGo on and take it!
//Doctor Shinigami vanishes.
What...?
If his words are true, this is our chance!
I don't really get it, but this is the moment!
I sense... a mighty power!
Rem, fight, you knoww!
Yeah... I'll try!
//Talk event when Black Rem and Rem engage.
You, who hold the same power as me... let me\nconfirm the source of that power!
//Event triggers when Black Rem's HP is reduced by 30%.
//Black Rem's and Rem's bodies glow.\n//SE: keeen, a resonance sound.
This is... I can feel it!\nPower - dream power - flowing into me!
What...? What have I been...?
Huh? She's acting strange!
Who are you...?
I'm Rem. And who are you?
I see, so that's how it is...
What do you know?
I'll understand if we fight, is that it!
Tch, you really want to fight?\nThen so be it!
//Event when Black Rem's HP is reduced to 50%.
Ugh! My will... it's coming back...!
//Black Rem's and Rem's bodies glow brighter.\n//SE: keeen, a resonance sound.
Dream power is filling me...!\nWith this, I can do it!!
Dream power!! Haaaaah!!
//Rem transforms into her Dream Hunter form.\n//Event CG: Dream Hunter Rem revived.
Rem-san...!
She transformed...!
([CLAUDE], this is amazing!\nWatch closely!)
Is that the real Rem-san...?
Yes! I am Rem the Dream Hunter!\nEnder of nightmares, protector of beautiful dreams!
//Event CG off.
Tch... so that's it...!\nHow dare you use my body\nfor something like that!
Used? What are you talking about!
I was made into a vessel\nto seal your power!
My power?
Oh well, now I'm free too.\nMight as well test my power!
You still want to fight!?
We're just getting started!
//Battle resumes.\n//Clear upon defeating Black Rem.
This is enough for now.\nIt seems I need a little more time.\nLet's meet again, Rem.
//Black Rem vanishes. Remaining grunts vanish too.
She's gone... Even with the REM-sleep waves gone,\nthe dream power isn't gone.
Rem-san!
Rem, can you get us out of here?
Of course, easy!
//Battle end.\n//Background: city (night)
Okay, good work, everyone.
W-wow, your outfit...!
My dream power's back.\nBut I'll catch a cold in winter.
Your dream power's back?
Yes. It was sealed inside my black self.\nWho did that,\nI still don't know.
Can you beat Doctor Shinigami now?
At least I can fight him evenly.\nAs fellow wielders of dream power.
That's good news.\nMii and Kei were problems, but\nDoctor Shinigami was the worst.
The undying fiend who appears in dreams to kill pretty girls -\nwe can finally exterminate him.
So where'd that old man go?
He has no intention of fighting here and now.
No idea what he wants.
Dejiko understands, nyo.\nHe's asking what meaning there'd be in beating\na pathetic humanoid mobile armor, nyo!
(Showing off by aiding your enemy and losing\nis nonsense too, nyu.)
Setting aside Doctor Shinigami's true motives,\nI feel much better now.\nI think I'll sleep well tonight!
That's wonderful.\nGood sleep is important.
Come to think of it, Cecilia-san,\nstill carrying your own pillow around?
Fufufu, prepare to be amazed!\nI can now sleep well\non a normal pillow!
Wow! Cecilia-san,\ncongratulations♪
(Cecilia-san\nstill has nightmares sometimes,\nbut I'll keep that to myself.)
//END
